content.short: Clipper is a decentralized exchange with the lowest per-transaction costs on trades under $50k.
content.description: Clipper is a decentralized exchange designed to lower per-transaction costs for small trades under $50k, making DeFi more accessible to retail traders. It uses a Formula Market Maker (FMM), a pricing model more complex than CPMM, to deliver real profits to liquidity providers. It maintains smaller pools to minimize fees and slippage for modest trades and offers two pool structures: Core Pools and Coves. Core Pools are multi-asset pools built from Core Assets, with LPs earning yield proportional to their stake in the pool.
